## Role of the website

::: {.profile-section}
The website is the public layer of MGenética: editorial, institutional and learning-oriented. It must remain simple to access, quick to publish, and modular enough so that pages, modules, scripts, and materials can be managed by an internal dashboard in the future.
:::

::: {.about-route role="region" aria-label="How the public experience is organized"}
::: {.about-route-copy}
## How the public experience is organized

MGenética was designed to lead the visitor through a complete learning route: enter on the main trail, consult support when necessary and close the journey with evidence of completion.
:::

::: {.about-route-steps role="list" aria-label="Public route of MGenética"}
::: {.about-route-step role="listitem"}
**To study**

The modules present concept, simulation and interpretation in sequence.
:::

::: {.about-route-step role="listitem"}
**Consult**

Search, glossary and script help you retrieve context without breaking the flow.
:::

::: {.about-route-step role="listitem"}
**Finish**

Quizzes and certificates record completion locally and publicly.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.public-page-triad role="list" aria-label="Roles of the public layer"}
::: {.public-page-card role="listitem"}
**Public layer**

Open, navigable and optimized content for reading.
:::

::: {.public-page-card role="listitem"}
**Modular content**

Pages, modules and scripts with predictable editorial structure.
:::

::: {.public-page-card role="listitem"}
**Internal management**

The app must support maintenance and publication without appearing as a public product.
:::
:::

::: {.about-credibility role="region" aria-label="Public trust commitments"}
::: {.about-credibility-copy}
## Public commitments

The public layer of MGenética needs to be understandable for those just starting out and technically honest for those who already work with data. Therefore, the experience privileges context, reproducibility and clear limits.
:::

::: {.about-credibility-grid role="list" aria-label="Editorial commitments of MGenética"}
::: {.about-credibility-item role="listitem"}
**No black box**

Each technical output must be linked to a question, a script and an interpretation.
:::

::: {.about-credibility-item role="listitem"}
**No mandatory login**

Public progress is in the browser and does not require login to study.
:::

::: {.about-credibility-item role="listitem"}
**No automatic certification**

The certificate indicates completion of the trail and does not replace training, professional validation or application without review.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.about-public-contract role="region" aria-label="Public contract of the MGenética experience"}
::: {.about-public-contract-copy}
## What public experience should guarantee

MGenética needs to remain clear for visitors and predictable for maintenance. Each public area must indicate what to study, where to seek support and what evidence closes the stage.
:::

::: {.about-public-contract-grid role="list" aria-label="Garantias públicas da MGenética"}
::: {.about-public-contract-item role="listitem"}
**Direction**

Every important page points to the next step of study.
:::

::: {.about-public-contract-item role="listitem"}
**Context**

Search, glossary and roadmap exist to support the trail, not to replace modules.
:::

::: {.about-public-contract-item role="listitem"}
**Evidence**

Conclusion means validated quiz, technical synthesis and applicable decision.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.about-editorial-boundary role="region" aria-label="Boundary between public experience and internal management"}
::: {.about-editorial-boundary-copy}
## What should remain public

MGenética may be managed by an internal app in the future, but the visible experience needs to remain editorial. The visitor should find content, direction and evidence, not administrative tools.
:::

::: {.about-editorial-boundary-grid role="list" aria-label="Fronteiras editoriais da MGenética"}
::: {.about-editorial-boundary-item role="listitem"}
**Public**

Pages, modules, scripts, search, glossary and certificate.
:::

::: {.about-editorial-boundary-item role="listitem"}
**Editable**

Metadata, navigation, declared regions and cards.
:::

::: {.about-editorial-boundary-item role="listitem"}
**Internal**

Publication, editorial review and administrative maintenance.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.about-visitor-path role="region" aria-label="How to evaluate whether the public experience is working"}
::: {.about-visitor-path-copy}
## How to recognize a good visit

An open house works when the person leaves with guidance, context, and a little evidence. This is the criterion that should guide future visual changes.
:::

::: {.about-visitor-path-grid role="list" aria-label="Sinais de uma visita pública bem orientada"}
::: {.about-visitor-path-item role="listitem"}
**Guidance**

The next page is obvious without relying on login.
:::

::: {.about-visitor-path-item role="listitem"}
**Context**

Search, glossary and roadmap reinforce the main trail.
:::

::: {.about-visitor-path-item role="listitem"}
**Evidence**

The session ends with a question, output or decision recorded.
:::
:::
:::

## Principles

::: {.profile-grid}
::: {.profile-card}
### Applied science

The modules prioritize real biological problems before formulas and computational outputs.
:::

::: {.profile-card}
### Reproducibility

R scripts and simulated data help repeat, compare, and interpret results.
:::

::: {.profile-card}
### Future management

Content is organized as pages, collections and metadata for future editing by an internal app.
:::
:::

## Editorial scope

::: {.profile-section}
- Animal improvement and response to selection.
- Quantitative genetics, genetic parameters and mixed models.
- Genetic evaluation, pedigree, kinship and BLUP.
- Applied genomics, quality control, GWAS and prediction.
:::

## Public structure

::: {.profile-grid .site-map-grid role="list" aria-label="Map of the main public areas"}
::: {.profile-card role="listitem"}
### Home page

It presents positioning, promise, route and calls for the trail.
:::

::: {.profile-card role="listitem"}
### Modules

They focus on reading, practice in R, interpretation and exercises.
:::

::: {.profile-card role="listitem"}
### Roadmap

Organizes the modules into a weekly study sequence.
:::
:::
